preconditions: Deterministic synthetic service and geography data exist
The target Client and Client Service are active
The selected service date matches configured_collection_day and has at least one due service
steps: Before publication confirm assignedStopCount is at least 1 and retain stop identity and planned drum count as evidence
Review candidate, publish and hand off
Inspect Route Operations, Live Operations and Needs Attention
cases.expectedOutcome: Office completes a region-scoped planning journey while financial and cross-scope boundaries remain enforced.
cases.actualOutcome: The region-scoped Office persona reviewed the active Monday client/service and geography, restored the Daily Roster module, Pretoria region and 2026-08-24 date across F5, and verified the preserved locked roster. The published Version 2 plan remained non-stale with one route, one assigned stop, zero unassigned services and two planned drums. The linked completed Route Operation retained the correct team, vehicle and Driver, 1/1 stops, 2/2 drums, near-capacity state and zero issues. Live Operations correctly excluded the completed operation and showed no positions, facts, warnings or Needs Attention. Driver financial isolation was independently proven.
defectReferences: Daily Roster date-context blocker resolved by PR #66 and verified in Shared Staging before completion

cases.journey: Driver route execution and offline synchronization
preconditions: Synthetic Driver is assigned a not-started Route Operation
The Route Operation date equals the current date in its service-region timezone
The assigned manifest contains at least one retained UAT stop
Any unsuitable prior operation is preserved as evidence and cancelled rather than deleted
steps: Authenticate and load only assigned manifest
Set near-capacity and complete eligible route
Confirm Office, financial and admin denial
cases.expectedOutcome: Assigned work synchronizes idempotently and privileged functions remain unavailable.
cases.actualOutcome: The assigned 2026-08-24 synthetic operation was accepted offline, synchronized automatically on reconnect, started on its service date, completed with one cleaned stop and two actual drums, retained near-capacity state, and disappeared from active Driver assignments after completion. Office independently confirmed completed, accepted and started state, 1/1 stops, 2/2 drums, zero remaining and zero open issues. The verified Driver actor was denied Office navigation, accounting status and region-scoped client master data.
defectReferences: Historical Driver reconciliation and lifecycle defects resolved before this execution; preserved prior-operation evidence was not cleared
